name: VITAMIN D TOTAL
description: Vitamin D Total measures combined 25-hydroxyvitamin D2 and D3 levels and evaluates vitamin D status, deficiency, and supplementation efficacy. This test assesses bone health, immune function, and metabolic disorders.

testdetails.instrumentation: Abbott Architect, Roche Elecsys, Beckman Coulter

literatureReview: Vitamin D Total measures 25-hydroxyvitamin D (25-OH-D), the major circulating form and best indicator of vitamin D status. Optimal range is 30-100 ng/mL. Deficiency (<20 ng/mL) causes rickets, osteomalacia, and increases fracture risk. Insufficiency (20-30 ng/mL) is common and associated with multiple health issues. Toxicity (>100 ng/mL) is rare but can cause hypercalcemia. Chemiluminescent immunoassay measures both D2 and D3 forms. Used in evaluation of bone disorders, malabsorption, obesity, and monitoring supplementation. Vitamin D deficiency is linked to autoimmune diseases, infections, and metabolic disorders. Seasonal variation and individual factors affect interpretation. The test guides vitamin D supplementation and monitors treatment efficacy.
